stem: A teammate at Kestrel Freight already generated and reviewed a plan file with `terraform plan -out=infra.tfplan`. Someone else now runs `terraform apply infra.tfplan`. What happens?

choices.text: Terraform regenerates a fresh plan and still prompts for approval before doing anything
Terraform performs exactly the operations recorded in that saved plan, without regenerating it or prompting for confirmation
Terraform refuses to run unless `-auto-approve` is also supplied alongside the plan file
Terraform treats the saved file as a suggestion and may skip actions that no longer seem necessary

rationale: Applying a saved plan file performs the operations it already contains without recomputing anything or prompting for confirmation, because approval already happened when the file was reviewed. It does not regenerate a fresh plan or prompt again; that only happens without a saved file. `-auto-approve` is unrelated to applying a saved plan file, since no prompt occurs either way. Terraform does not selectively skip actions in a saved plan; it carries out exactly what the file recorded.
